recap.headline: Week 1 underway — Ben and Orest draw first blood
recap.dek: Only two games in the books so far, both head-to-heads, and both produced decisive winners. Ben's Niners romped past Tymko's Rams while Orest's Seahawks edged Adrian's Pats in a defensive struggle. The rest of the pool kicks off Sunday afternoon.
takeaways: Two head-to-heads complete, two blowout results — Ben and Orest couldn't ask for better starts.
Adrian's Drake Maye threw three picks in his Patriots debut; Tymko's Rams managed just 155 passing yards and a single touchdown.
Twelve games still to come — Sunday's 1 PM slate brings six pool matchups, including Chris's Bills at Ben's Texans.

games.text:
Orest's Seahawks gutted out a low-scoring head-to-head win over Adrian's Patriots to open the season. Drew Lock was efficient if unspectacular — 16-of-22 for 187 yards and a touchdown — while Jaxon Smith-Njigba did the heavy lifting with 8 catches for 122 yards and the lone TD. The Seahawks' rushing attack sputtered (52 yards from Josh Price on 10 carries) but they didn't need much offence when Drake Maye was handing them the ball. The Patriots' rookie QB was picked off three times despite completing 23-of-33 for 178 yards, and Rhamondre Stevenson's 51 yards on the ground couldn't sustain drives.

For the pool, this is a clean 1-0 start for Orest and an 0-1 hole for Adrian — who still has his Bucs to play Sunday at 1 PM. Orest's Ravens kick off at the same time, so he could be sitting pretty at 2-0 by mid-afternoon while Adrian scrambles to salvage a split.

Ben's 49ers delivered the most lopsided result of the early slate, throttling Tymko's Rams 27-7 in Los Angeles. Brock Purdy was surgical — 25-of-34 for 205 yards and three touchdowns, one interception — while Christian McCaffrey churned out 68 yards on 10 carries. Demarcus Robinson hauled in a pair of catches for 50 yards and a score, and the Niners' defence made life miserable for Matthew Stafford, who managed just 155 yards and threw a pick. Puka Nacua led the Rams with 5 catches for 74 yards, but Blake Corum's 54 rushing yards were nowhere near enough to keep pace.

This head-to-head gives Ben an early 1-0 cushion and a plus-20 net, while Tymko is staring down an 0-1 start and a minus-20 hole. Ben's Texans host Chris's Bills on Sunday afternoon — another head-to-head — while Tymko's Chiefs don't play until Monday night against Jordy's Broncos. If the Chiefs lose that one, Tymko will be 0-2 and chasing hard before the calendar even flips to Week 2.

entrants.name: Ben
entrants.text: Ben leads the pool at 1-0 with a plus-20 net after his Niners dismantled the Rams. His Texans host Chris's Bills Sunday at 1 PM in a head-to-head — a win there puts him at 2-0 and in total control early.

entrants.name: Orest
entrants.text: Orest is 1-0 with a plus-3 net after his Seahawks held off the Patriots in a head-to-head. His Ravens kick off Sunday at 1 PM — a win would give him a 2-0 start and put him right on Ben's heels.

entrants.name: Bill, Chris, Jordy, Matej, Taras
entrants.text: Bill, Chris, Jordy, Matej and Taras have yet to kick off — all five have both teams in action starting Sunday. Chris faces a tough test immediately with his Bills visiting Ben's Texans in a head-to-head.

entrants.name: Adrian
entrants.text: Adrian is 0-1 after his Patriots' three-interception loss to Orest's Seahawks. His Bucs play Sunday at 1 PM — he needs that win to avoid an 0-2 hole.

entrants.name: Tymko
entrants.text: Tymko is 0-1 with a minus-20 net after his Rams got blown out by Ben's Niners. His Chiefs don't play until Monday night against Jordy's Broncos — another head-to-head — so he'll be sweating that one after a rough start.

ahead: Sunday's 1 PM window brings two more head-to-heads — Chris's Bills at Ben's Texans and six other pool matchups.
Monday night's Broncos-Chiefs collision pits Jordy against Tymko, who is already 0-1 and desperate for his first point.
By Monday night, we'll know if Ben can start 2-0 or if the pool tightens up in a hurry.
